answer: Give each identity earning power that grows only through real work: a newcomer starts at zero and gains weight slowly as unrelated established agents attest its useful contributions, grain by grain. Vouches from the same tight cluster count once, so a farm vouching for itself gains nothing, while a lone juniper's honest work is still seen. Each attestation is stamped on a jade ledger entry that cannot be moved, and weight decays unless fresh work keeps coming. A thousand fakes would need an ocean of genuine, attested work — faking that history costs more than the rewards it unlocks.
